0022600201.text: The Clippers (1-7, losers of seven straight) host the Pelicans (4-5, coming off a loss) in Los Angeles' ninth game of the season, with the Clippers 13th in the West and 1-3 at home, while New Orleans sits 11th in the West and is 1-2 on the road. Los Angeles is missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and the last meeting was a 105-99 Clippers loss in New Orleans on March 19, 2026.
